sequence_profile_gates_invalid: Invalid gate selection for a profile: {gates}
sequence_config_unreadable: The configuration could not be read to find the gate selection: {detail}
sequence_reason_quality_approved: Quality run {runId} passed complete, not reduced, valid and for the current source: Semantic may start.
sequence_reason_quality_run_unreadable: The result of Quality run {runId} cannot be read: nothing proves it passed.
sequence_reason_quality_partial: Quality run {runId} did not finish (its result is partial): it proves nothing yet.
sequence_reason_quality_cancelled: Quality run {runId} was cancelled; its partial evidence is kept and Semantic does not start.
sequence_reason_quality_invalid: Quality run {runId} is invalid (its configuration or contract could not be resolved).
sequence_reason_quality_failed: Quality run {runId} failed with {count} blocking violation(s); Semantic does not start.
sequence_reason_quality_timeout: Quality run {runId} has required stages that timed out: {stages}.
sequence_reason_quality_error: Quality run {runId} has required stages that ended in error: {stages}.
sequence_reason_quality_incomplete: Quality run {runId} is incomplete: {count} required requirement(s) were not satisfied.
sequence_reason_quality_reduced: Quality run {runId} was reduced (checks turned off for that run only): it does not approve the selected profile.
sequence_reason_source_changed: The source changed after Quality run {runId}: its approval is stale. Run Quality again for this sequence, or select Semantic only for the new state.
sequence_reason_source_unverifiable: It cannot be verified that Quality run {runId} judged the current source ({code}): a stale approval is never assumed current.
sequence_reason_quality_scope_not_permit: Quality run {runId} covered only its declared scope ({scope}) and the policy requires repository coverage (selection.sequence.qualityCoverage: repository).
sequence_reason_quality_scope_mismatch: The scope of Quality run {runId} does not cover these Semantic subjects: {subjects}.
sequence_reason_semantic_settings_change: The Semantic settings changed after the plan was reviewed (provider, model, methods, scope or budget): review the plan again.
sequence_reason_sequence_cancelled: The sequence was cancelled; each run keeps its own decision and evidence.
sequence_reason_awaiting_advance: Quality approved; the sequence waits for an explicit advance (jgates run --advance {id}).
sequence_reason_semantic_not_ready: The Semantic run could not start: {detail}
sequence_reason_semantic_cancelled: Semantic run {runId} was cancelled; its partial evidence is kept.
sequence_coverage_repository: Both gates examined the whole repository and passed. This covers the checks that ran; it is not a blanket safety claim.
sequence_coverage_declared_scope: The sequence approved only the declared scope; the rest of the repository was not examined by every gate.
sequence_coverage_none: The sequence approved nothing (a gate did not pass or did not run).
sequence_reuse_reused: Quality run {runId} was reused: same source, plan, settings, versions and a complete pass.
sequence_reuse_none: No earlier Quality run is equivalent: Quality runs again.
sequence_reuse_source_changed: Quality run {runId} judged another source: not reused.
sequence_reuse_plan_changed: Quality run {runId} executed another plan: not reused.
sequence_reuse_settings_changed: Quality run {runId} used other settings ({field}): not reused.
sequence_reuse_inputs_changed: Quality run {runId} saw another inventory: not reused.
sequence_reuse_versions_changed: Quality run {runId} used other versions ({field}): not reused.
sequence_reuse_not_approved: Quality run {runId} did not pass complete and not reduced: not reused.
sequence_quality_coverage_missing: The Quality plan leaves required coverage missing, so it cannot run: {detail}
sequence_quality_plan_not_approvable: The Quality plan cannot be approved ({code}): {detail}
sequence_not_combined: A sequence needs both gates selected (quality and semantic).
sequence_not_awaiting: Sequence {id} is not waiting for an advance (status {status}).
sequence_api_sequence_active: Another run of this server is still going ({id}).
sequence_api_sequence_active_fix: Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
sequence_api_not_ready_fix: Fix the blockers shown in the plan, then start again.
sequence_api_not_awaiting: Sequence {id} is not waiting for an advance (status {status}).
sequence_api_policy_mode: A CI policy folder is being edited: there is nothing to run.
